name: Faceless Wager

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The wager makes three attacks, using Rapier or Mark in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Leaden Pall.

Actions.name: Rapier
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 28 (5d8 + 6) Piercing damage.

Actions.name: Mark
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +10, range 80/320 ft. 24 (4d8 + 6) Psychic damage.

Actions.name: Leaden Pall
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target's Speed is halved and it can't take Reactions until the end of the wager's next turn.
Actions.gmQuote: a duellist who only ever makes one attack and it always lands

Bonus Actions.name: Umbral Step
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the wager takes the Hide action.

Traits.name: Gloom Surety
Traits.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness and hidden, when the wager makes a Mark attack against a creature that cannot see it, the attack hits without needing to beat the target's AC.
Traits.clause: The wager's shadow-stuffed body makes it unseen in the dark—while in Dim Light or Darkness, it can Hide even when it has
Traits.expressedQuote: the attack hits without needing to beat the target's AC

lore: A champion duellist who wagered his face, name, and every loss to a shadow-court patron, and now stalks the roads demanding single-stroke satisfaction from any blade it deems worthy.

unplaced.text: The wager fights like a duellist: clean lines, a rapier's reach, each mark placed as though the bout were already won.
